label: Show public IP (Terminal command)
body:
# Prints your public IPv4 — paste into Terminal and press Enter
curl -4s https://api.ipify.org

# Alternative (IPv4 or IPv6 depending on your network)
# curl -s https://ifconfig.me

label: Show local IP on macOS (Terminal)
body:
# Wi‑Fi (usually en0 on MacBooks)
ipconfig getifaddr en0

# If empty, try Ethernet or other interface
# ipconfig getifaddr en1

# List all IPv4 addresses on the machine
# ifconfig | grep "inet "

label: Conventional commit message (full template)
body:
feat(your-scope): short imperative summary (aim for ~50–72 chars)

Explain why this change exists and the approach you took. Wrap lines
around ~72 characters so `git log` stays easy to read in a terminal.

- user-visible or technical bullet
- tests / docs / migration notes if relevant

Refs: #123
# Co-authored-by: Name <name@example.com>
